scientific_integrity: All limiting statements have analytic proofs using exact cylinder inclusions and Brunn--Minkowski. The bundled script checks formulas and rigorous asymptotic brackets but is not used as a substitute for the proof. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem gives a witness family with limiting efficiency 2^{-d}, and thus an upper bound on the unrestricted Steiner-selector worst case; it does not prove that the upper bound is globally sharp. It compares selectors decisively only in the plane. Finite-parameter optimal translations are not classified. Some unindexed prior literature may overlap.
title: Transverse long spikes defeat Steiner-point overlap alignment
